Your own templates: slides you want to reuse, in this folder (`course/guide/01-my-templates/`). They're listed here, above Chalkline's own templates, and only on the teacher site.

To start one, copy a slide from Chalkline's guide (below) or from one of your lessons into a new file here, for example `my-templates-slides.qmd`, with the usual labels at the top (`title`, `type: slides`, `order`, `audience: [teacher]`, `description`).
